consequence.statement: Values set under endpointStatus no longer take effect; the additional endpoint statuses in the CiliumEndpoints CRD are no longer provided.
consequence.remediation: Remove endpointStatus keys and monitor endpoints via Cilium metrics (cilium_policy, cilium_policy_endpoint_enforcement_status, cilium_controllers_failing, cilium_endpoint_state) or `cilium-dbg endpoint get`.

original.statement: The Helm option `endpointStatus` has been removed

decision.reason: The 1.16 upgrade notes [ev-f050ccf90d86] say the Helm option `endpointStatus` has been removed. They tell operators to stop relying on the extra statuses in the CiliumEndpoints CRD and to use Cilium metrics or `cilium-dbg endpoint get` instead. A removed values key whose settings are no longer honoured is setting-ignored. The statement and remediation in the proposal match the evidence's own wording, so fact vf-7f11701832ba is still correct. The values.yaml excerpts [ev-28e0ccb5774a][ev-39a22d88e2f5] only show file headers, so they neither confirm nor contradict this.
